subject.name: Entrepreneurship
subject.examPattern: School-conducted annual exam (no CBSE SQP for Class XI); 3 h; same marks split and question design as Class XII; 50% competency-based, 20% MCQ, 30% short/long answer (Circular 30/2024). Theory 70 + Project 30. Assumed 34 questions (XII template: 18×1, 6×2, 5×3, 5×5).
